title: Happy hedgehog
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body / spines -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='34' ry='24' fill='#6b4a2f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='31' ry='21' fill='#8a6338'/>
  <!-- spine spikes -->
  <g fill='#5a3d26'>
    <polygon points='22,50 30,38 36,52'/>
    <polygon points='34,44 43,32 48,46'/>
    <polygon points='46,42 56,30 61,44'/>
    <polygon points='58,42 68,32 72,46'/>
    <polygon points='70,46 79,38 82,52'/>
  </g>
  <!-- belly / face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='15' fill='#f0c78a'/>
  <!-- face snout area -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#f7d9a8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='58' r='5' fill='#e8b87c'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='58' r='5' fill='#e8b87c'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='65' r='3.5' fill='#3a2416'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='65' r='3.5' fill='#3a2416'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='64' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='64' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='73' r='3.2' fill='#4a2c1a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44,77 Q50,82 56,77' stroke='#a06a3a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='74' r='3' fill='#f2a0a0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='74' r='3' fill='#f2a0a0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e8b87c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e8b87c'/>
</svg>
